line: Reach out to someone new and make them feel welcome.
paragraph: Jane Johnson runs a gym in Kaysville, Utah, and had watched a young woman named Aubry Allbridge move through classes for several years. Aubry remembered every routine with unusual ease. Johnson helped her train to become a certified instructor for UpBeat Barre, a popular fitness program. Now Aubry, who is twenty-two and has Down Syndrome, leads a room of sixty people through their exercises. She calls out the steps they have all come to recognize from her. The class shows up early to save a spot near the front.
